## Acceptance Criteria → Test Case Coverage
| AC | Criterion | Test cases | Covered |
|----|-----------|------------|---------|
| AC-1 | Home page is a Server Component fetching global/personal feed, incl. pagination + popular-tags sidebar | TC-E2E-01, TC-E2E-02, TC-INT-01, TC-INT-02, TC-A11Y-01, TC-A11Y-02, TC-A11Y-03, TC-A11Y-06, TC-A11Y-07, TC-PERF-01 | ✅ |
| AC-2 | Article view page is a Server Component rendering a single article (markdown body + comments list) | TC-E2E-03, TC-E2E-04, TC-INT-05, TC-A11Y-04, TC-A11Y-05, TC-A11Y-06, TC-A11Y-07, TC-PERF-02 | ✅ |
| AC-3 | FeedContext replaced by URL search params driving Server-Component re-render (switching feeds/tags is navigation, not client state) | TC-E2E-02, TC-E2E-03, TC-E2E-05, TC-SEC-04, TC-PERF-04 | ✅ |
| AC-4 | Both pages render without hydration errors and reflect correct favorited/following for the session (or false for anonymous) | TC-INT-03, TC-INT-04, TC-SEC-01, TC-SEC-02, TC-SEC-03, TC-PERF-03 | ✅ |
| AC-5 | Pagination works identically to current behavior (limit/offset query params) | TC-E2E-05, TC-INT-06, TC-SEC-04 | ✅ |

**Coverage check**: 5/5 acceptance criteria have at least one happy-path AND at least one negative/boundary test case. ✅

Negative/boundary coverage confirmation:
- AC-1 → negative/boundary: TC-INT-02 (no orphan/hardcoded tags), TC-A11Y-02 (missing focus indicator), TC-A11Y-07 (200% zoom reflow).
- AC-2 → negative: TC-E2E-04 (non-existent slug → not-found, not crash).
- AC-3 → negative/boundary: TC-E2E-05 (deep-link cold load reconstructs state), TC-SEC-04 (injection-style tag/offset params).
- AC-4 → negative: TC-INT-04, TC-SEC-01, TC-SEC-02 (anonymous/cross-user favorited=false/following=false), TC-PERF-03 (zero hydration errors).
- AC-5 → boundary: TC-INT-06 (offset windowing), TC-SEC-04 (invalid/negative/huge offset).
